┌─ Help: The mouse and the sidebar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ The mouse                                                                                                                                │
│   Click the ground to walk there; the server plans the route, inside this zone. The first click on a mob or a person selects it and      │
│   opens a small card (name, title, level, difficulty, what they offer); a second click, or F (attack) or G (talk), acts. A first click   │
│   never attacks. Click loot to pick up everything within reach.                                                                          │
│   Hover for a name and title beside the pointer. Hold Alt over the map to name everything on it; if your terminal does not send Alt with │
│   the mouse, Ctrl+A turns the names on and off. The wheel zooms (+ and - do too). M opens the large map: click a spot to walk there, or  │
│   move the cursor with the arrows and press Enter.                                                                                       │
│   Right-click lets go of the selection, as Esc does. Shift+click is never used: terminals keep it for selecting text.                    │
│   Every mouse action has a key: arrows or WASD walk, Tab selects, F and G act, L loots, + and - zoom, Ctrl+A names. The game is fully    │
│   playable without a mouse.                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ The character sidebar                                                                                                                    │
│   Beside a trader, a trainer, the bank, a contract board or a conversation sits your character: Gear (what you wear), Bags (what you     │
│   carry, stacked, "Wolf Pelt ×2") and Stats (health, armour, accuracy, what your swing does now, bare hands too, and what gear adds to   │
│   each attribute). C turns to the next tab; click a tab to pick it; PgUp and PgDn or the wheel scroll. In a narrow window C holds the    │
│   sidebar open as a drawer and C or Esc puts it away.                                                                                    │
│   Every item says how it compares with what you wear in its slot: ▲ better, ▼ worse, = about the same, x you cannot use it (the card     │
│   says why). What you cannot afford is greyed out with how many crowns you are short. At a vendor, J sells all your junk (things with no │
│   gear slot that no contract of yours wants), A sells the whole stack under the cursor.                                                  │
